healing_focus.name: Healing Focus
healing_focus.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks  while casting any holy healing and damaging spell by [V1]%.

improved_renew.name: Improved Renew
improved_renew.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by [V1]%.

holy_specialization.name: Holy Specialization
holy_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by [V1]%.

spell_warding.name: Spell Warding
spell_warding.tooltipTemplate: Reduces all spell damage taken by [V1]%.

divine_fury.name: Divine Fury
divine_fury.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal and Greater Heal spells by [V1] sec.

blessed_recovery.name: Blessed Recovery
blessed_recovery.tooltipTemplate: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, Blessed Recovery heals you for [V1]% of the damage taken over 6 sec.  Additional critical hits taken during the effect increase the healing received.

afterkindling.name: Afterkindling
afterkindling.tooltipTemplate: Increases your damage done by [V1]% to targets affected by your Holy Fire and reduces the mana cost of Smite and Holy Fire by [V2]%.

inspiration.name: Inspiration
inspiration.tooltipTemplate: Reduces your target's physical damage taken by [V1]% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from your Flash Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Binding Heal, Penance, Prayer of Mending, Prayer of Healing, or Circle of Healing spell.

holy_reach.name: Holy Reach
holy_reach.tooltipTemplate: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing, Holy Nova, Divine Hymn and Circle of Healing spells by [V1]%.

improved_healing.name: Improved Healing
improved_healing.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Divine Hymn and Penance spells by [V1]%.

searing_light.name: Searing Light
searing_light.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage of your Smite, Holy Fire, Holy Nova and Penance spells by [V1]%.

blessed_vengeance.name: Blessed Vengeance
blessed_vengeance.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage of your Holy Fire, Holy Nova, Penance and Smite by [V1]%.

healing_prayers.name: Healing Prayers
healing_prayers.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Prayer of Healing and Prayer of Mending spell by [V1]%.

spirit_of_redemption.name: Spirit of Redemption
spirit_of_redemption.tooltipTemplate: Increases total Spirit by 5% and upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec.  The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects.  While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost.  When the effect ends, the priest dies.

spiritual_guidance.name: Spiritual Guidance
spiritual_guidance.tooltipTemplate: Increases spell power by [V1]% of your total Spirit.

surge_of_light.name: Surge of Light
surge_of_light.tooltipTemplate: Your spell criticals have a [V1]% chance to cause your next Smite or Flash Heal spell to be instant cast, generate no threat and cost no mana but be incapable of a critical hit.  This effect lasts 10 sec.

spiritual_healing.name: Spiritual Healing
spiritual_healing.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount healed by your healing spells by [V1]%.

holy_concentration.name: Holy Concentration
holy_concentration.tooltipTemplate: Your mana regeneration from spirit is increased by [V1]% for 12 sec after you critically heal with Flash Heal, Greater Heal, Binding Heal or Empowered Renew, or critically hit with Smite.

lightwell.name: Lightwell
lightwell.tooltipTemplate:
Creates a Holy Lightwell. 

Lightwell will attempt to heal a nearby party or raid member within 20 yards every second if they have less than 50% health for 876.68. 

Lightwell lasts for 30 seconds or until it heals 10 times.

blessed_resilience.name: Blessed Resilience
blessed_resilience.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by [V1]%, and critical hits made against you have a [V2]% chance to prevent you from being critically hit again for 6 sec.

radiant_fury.name: Radiant Fury
radiant_fury.tooltipTemplate:
Your Smite, Holy Fire and the damage of Holy Nova gains an additional [V1]% of your bonus spell damage effects.

Increase the spell haste of all party and raid members within 50 yards by [V2]%.

body_and_soul.name: Body and Soul
body_and_soul.tooltipTemplate: When you cast Power Word: Shield, you increase the target's movement speed by [V1]% for 4 sec, and you have a [V2]% chance when you cast Abolish Disease on yourself to also cleanse 1 poison effect in addition to diseases.

empowered_healing.name: Empowered Healing
empowered_healing.tooltipTemplate: Your Greater Heal spell gains an additional [V1]% and your Flash Heal and Binding Heal gain an additional [V2]% of your bonus healing effects.

serendipity.name: Serendipity
serendipity.tooltipTemplate: When you heal with Binding Heal or Flash Heal, the cast time and mana cost of your next Greater Heal or Prayer of Healing spell is reduced by [V1]%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 20 sec.

divine_accuracy.name: Divine Accuracy
divine_accuracy.tooltipTemplate: Increases your hit rating by [V1]% of your Spirit and increases the duration of Holy Fire by [V2] sec.

empowered_renew.name: Empowered Renew
empowered_renew.tooltipTemplate: Your Renew spell gains an additional [V1]% of your bonus healing effects, and your Renew will instantly heal the target for [V2]% of the total periodic effect.

circle_of_healing.name: Circle of Healing
circle_of_healing.tooltipTemplate: Heals up to 5 friendly party or raid members within 15 yards of the target for 347.

test_of_faith.name: Test of Faith
test_of_faith.tooltipTemplate: Increases healing by [V1]% on friendly targets at or below 50% health.

divine_providence.name: Divine Providence
divine_providence.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount healed by Circle of Healing, Binding Heal, Holy Nova, Prayer of Healing, Divine Hymn and Prayer of Mending by [V1]%, and reduces the cooldown of your Prayer of Mending by [V2]%.

epiphany_of_light.name: Epiphany of Light
epiphany_of_light.tooltipTemplate:
@req:1133154;0:req@
The periodic damage of Holy Fire has a [V1]% chance to trigger Surge of Light. In addition, the periodic damage of Holy Fire is increased by [V2]%.

guardian_spirit.name: Guardian Spirit
guardian_spirit.tooltipTemplate: Calls upon a guardian spirit to watch over the friendly target. The spirit increases the healing received by the target by 40%, and also prevents the target from dying by sacrificing itself.  This sacrifice terminates the effect but heals the target of 50% of their maximum health. Lasts 10 sec.

spirit_tap.name: Spirit Tap
spirit_tap.tooltipTemplate: Gives you a [V1]% chance to gain a 100% bonus to your Spirit after killing a target that yields experience or honor.  For the duration, your mana will regenerate at a 100% rate while casting.  Lasts 15 sec.

improved_spirit_tap.name: Improved Spirit Tap
improved_spirit_tap.tooltipTemplate:
@req:1115336:0:req@
Your Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death critical strikes have a 100% chance and your Mind Flay critical strikes have a 50% chance to increase your total Spirit by [V1]%. For the duration, your mana will regenerate at a [V2]% rate while casting. Lasts 10 sec.

darkness.name: Darkness
darkness.tooltipTemplate: Increases your Shadow spell damage by [V1]%.

shadow_affinity.name: Shadow Affinity
shadow_affinity.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the threat generated by your Shadow spells by [V1]%, and you receive [V2]% of your base mana when your Shadow Word: Pain or Vampiric Touch spells are dispelled.

improved_shadow_word_pain.name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain
improved_shadow_word_pain.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by [V1]%.

shadow_focus.name: Shadow Focus
shadow_focus.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to hit with your Shadow spells by [V1]%, and reduces the mana cost of your Shadow spells by [V2]%.

improved_psychic_scream.name: Improved Psychic Scream
improved_psychic_scream.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by [V1] sec.

improved_mind_blast.name: Improved Mind Blast
improved_mind_blast.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by [V1] sec, and while in Shadowform your Mind Blast also has a [V2]% chance to reduce all healing done to the target by 20% for 10 sec.

mind_flay.name: Mind Flay
mind_flay.tooltipTemplate: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 45 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

veiled_shadows.name: Veiled Shadows
veiled_shadows.tooltipTemplate: Decreases the cooldown of your Fade ability by 6 sec, and reduces the cooldown of your Shadowfiend ability by 2 minutes.

shadow_reach.name: Shadow Reach
shadow_reach.tooltipTemplate: Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by [V1]%.

shadow_weaving.name: Shadow Weaving
shadow_weaving.tooltipTemplate: Your Shadow damage spells have a [V1]% chance to increase the Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 15 sec.  Stacks up to 5 times.

silence.name: Silence
silence.tooltipTemplate: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec.  Non-player victim spellcasting is also interrupted for 3 sec.

vampiric_embrace.name: Vampiric Embrace
vampiric_embrace.tooltipTemplate: Fills you with the embrace of Shadow energy, causing you to be healed for 8% and other party members to be healed for 2% of any single-target Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 min.

improved_vampiric_embrace.name: Improved Vampiric Embrace
improved_vampiric_embrace.tooltipTemplate: Increases the healing done from Vampiric Embrace by [V1]%.

focused_mind.name: Focused Mind
focused_mind.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Mind Blast, Mind Control, Mind Flay and Mind Sear spells by [V1]%.

mind_melt.name: Mind Melt
mind_melt.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Mind Blast, Mind Flay and Mind Sear spells by [V1]%, and increases the periodic critical strike chance of your Vampiric Touch, Devouring Plague and Shadow Word: Pain spells by [V2]%.

improved_devouring_plague.name: Improved Devouring Plague
improved_devouring_plague.tooltipTemplate: Increases the periodic damage done by your Devouring Plague by [V1]%, and when you cast Devouring Plague you instantly deal damage equal to [V2]% of its total periodic effect.

shadowform.name: Shadowform
shadowform.tooltipTemplate:
Assume a Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 15%, reducing all damage done to you by 15% and threat generated by 30%.  However, you may not cast Holy spells while in this form except Cure Disease and Abolish Disease. 

Grants the periodic damage from your Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague, and Vampiric Touch spells the ability to critically hit for 100% and the ability to benefit from haste.

shadow_power.name: Shadow Power
shadow_power.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Mind Blast, Mind Flay, and Shadow Word: Death spells by [V1]%.

improved_shadowform.name: Improved Shadowform
improved_shadowform.tooltipTemplate: Your Fade ability now has a [V1]% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when used while in Shadowform, and reduces casting or channeling time lost when damaged by [V2]% when casting any Shadow spell while in Shadowform.

misery.name: Misery
misery.tooltipTemplate: Your Shadow Word: Pain, Mind Flay, Mind Sear and Vampiric Touch spells also increase the chance for harmful spells to hit by [V1]% lasting 24 sec, and increases the benefit from spell power gained by your Mind Blast, Mind Flay and Mind Sear spells by [V2]%.

psychic_horror.name: Psychic Horror
psychic_horror.tooltipTemplate: You terrify the target, causing them to tremble in horror for 3 sec and drop their main hand and ranged weapons for 10 sec.

vampiric_touch.name: Vampiric Touch
vampiric_touch.tooltipTemplate: Causes 505 Shadow damage over 15 sec to your target and causes up to 10 party or raid members to gain 1% of their maximum mana per 5 sec when you deal damage from Mind Blast. In addition, if the Vampiric Touch is dispelled it will cause 808 damage to the afflicted target.

pain_and_suffering.name: Pain and Suffering
pain_and_suffering.tooltipTemplate: Your Mind Flay and Mind Sear have a [V1]% chance to refresh the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain on the target, and reduces the damage you take from your own Shadow Word: Death by [V2]%.

twisted_faith.name: Twisted Faith
twisted_faith.tooltipTemplate: Increases your spell power by [V1]% of your total Spirit, and your damage done by your Mind Flay and Mind Blast is increased by [V2]% if your target is afflicted by your Shadow Word: Pain.

dispersion.name: Dispersion
dispersion.tooltipTemplate: You disperse into pure Shadow energy, reducing all damage taken by 90%.  You are unable to attack or cast spells, but you regenerate 6% mana every 1 sec for 6 sec. Dispersion can be cast while stunned, feared or silenced and clears all snare and movement impairing effects when cast, and makes you immune to them while dispersed.

unbreakable_will.name: Unbreakable Will
unbreakable_will.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects done to you by an additional [V1]%.

twin_disciplines.name: Twin Disciplines
twin_disciplines.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage and healing done by your instant spells by [V1]%.

silent_resolve.name: Silent Resolve
silent_resolve.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the threat generated by your Holy and Discipline spells by [V1]% and reduces the chance your helpful spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled by [V2]%.

improved_inner_fire.name: Improved Inner Fire
improved_inner_fire.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effect of your Inner Fire spell by [V1]%, and increases the total number of charges by [V2].

improved_power_word_fortitude.name: Improved Power Word: Fortitude
improved_power_word_fortitude.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effect of your Power Word: Fortitude and Prayer of Fortitude spells by [V1]%, and increases your total Stamina by [V2]%.

martyrdom.name: Martyrdom
martyrdom.tooltipTemplate: Gives you a [V1]% chance to gain the Focused Casting effect that lasts for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike.  The Focused Casting effect reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Priest spells and decreases the duration of Interrupt effects by [V2]%.

meditation.name: Meditation
meditation.tooltipTemplate: Allows [V1]% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.

inner_focus.name: Inner Focus
inner_focus.tooltipTemplate: When activated, reduces the mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is capable of a critical effect.

improved_power_word_shield.name: Improved Power Word: Shield
improved_power_word_shield.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by [V1]%.

absolution.name: Absolution
absolution.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Dispel Magic, Cure Disease, Abolish Disease and Mass Dispel spells by [V1]%.

mental_agility.name: Mental Agility
mental_agility.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your instant cast spells by [V1]%.

improved_mana_burn.name: Improved Mana Burn
improved_mana_burn.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by [V1] sec.

reflective_shield.name: Reflective Shield
reflective_shield.tooltipTemplate: Causes [V1]% of the damage you absorb with Power Word: Shield to reflect back at the attacker.  This damage causes no threat.

soul_warding.name: Soul Warding
soul_warding.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Power Word: Shield ability by 4 sec, and reduces the mana cost of your Power Word: Shield by 15%.

focused_power.name: Focused Power
focused_power.tooltipTemplate: Increases damage and healing done by your spells by [V1]%. In addition, your Mass Dispel cast time is reduced by [V2] sec.

enlightenment.name: Enlightenment
enlightenment.tooltipTemplate: Increases your total Spirit by [V1]% and increases your spell haste by [V2]%.

focused_will.name: Focused Will
focused_will.tooltipTemplate: Increases your spell critical effect chance by [V1]%, and after taking a critical hit you gain the Focused Will effect, reducing all damage taken by [V2]% and increasing healing effects on you by [V3]%.  Stacks up to 3 times.  Lasts 8 sec.

power_infusion.name: Power Infusion
power_infusion.tooltipTemplate: Infuses the target with power, increasing spell casting speed by 20% and reducing the mana cost of all spells by 20%.  Lasts 15 sec.

improved_flash_heal.name: Improved Flash Heal
improved_flash_heal.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Flash Heal by [V1]%, and increases the critical effect chance of your Flash Heal by [V2]% on friendly targets at or below 50% health.

renewed_hope.name: Renewed Hope
renewed_hope.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical effect chance of your Flash Heal, Greater Heal and Penance (Heal) spells by [V1]% on targets afflicted by the Weakened Soul effect, and you have a [V2]% chance to reduce all damage taken by 3% for 1 min to all friendly party and raid targets when you cast Power Word: Shield. This effect has a 15 sec cooldown.

rapture.name: Rapture
rapture.tooltipTemplate: When your Power Word: Shield is completely absorbed or dispelled you are instantly energized with [V1]% of your total mana, and you have a [V2]% chance to energize your shielded target with 2% total mana, 8 rage, 16 energy or 32 runic power. This can not occur more than once every 10 sec.

aspiration.name: Aspiration
aspiration.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Inner Focus, Power Infusion, Pain Suppression and Penance spells by [V1]%.

divine_aegis.name: Divine Aegis
divine_aegis.tooltipTemplate: Critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing [V1]% of the amount healed. Lasts 12 sec.

pain_suppression.name: Pain Suppression
pain_suppression.tooltipTemplate: Instantly reduces a friendly target's threat by 5%, reduces all damage taken by 40% and increases resistance to Dispel mechanics by 65% for 8 sec.

grace.name: Grace
grace.tooltipTemplate: Your Flash Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance spells have a [V1]% chance to bless the target with Grace, increasing all healing received from the Priest by 3%. This effect will stack up to 3 times. Effect lasts 15 sec.

borrowed_time.name: Borrowed Time
borrowed_time.tooltipTemplate: Grants [V1]% spell haste for your next spell after casting Power Word: Shield, and increases the amount absorbed by your Power Word: Shield equal to [V2]% of your spell power.

penance.name: Penance
penance.tooltipTemplate: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 205 Holy damage to an enemy, or 570 to 643 healing to an ally instantly and every 0.95 sec for 2 sec.

enchants.name: Angelic Feather
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Angelic Feather. 
Angelic Feather: 3 Charges
20 sec recharge
Place a feather at the target location, lasting for 15 sec. If allies walk through it, they gain 50% increased movement speed for 4 sec.

enchants.name: Holy Word: Chastise
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Holy Word: Chastise. 
Holy Word: Chastise: Chastise the target, incapacitating it for 3 sec. Any damage caused will revive the target.

enchants.name: Leap of Faith
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Leap of Faith. 
Leap of Faith: Pulls the spirit of a party or raid member, moving them to you. The same target can only be affected by this once every 30 seconds.

enchants.name: Power Word: Barrier
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Power Word: Barrier.
 
Power Word: Barrier: Summons a holy barrier to protect all allies at the target location for 8 sec, reducing all damage taken by 20% and reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting by 100%.

enchants.name: Void Shift
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Void Shift. 
Void Shift: You and the currently targeted party or raid member swap health percentages. Increases the health percentage of you and your ally to 10% if below that amount.

enchants.name: Accelerated Ascension
enchants.tooltip: Casting Smite reduces the cooldown of Holy Fire and Guardian Spirit by 0 second.

enchants.name: Centered
enchants.tooltip:
Your Holy Word: Chastise deals Holy damage to monsters, chaining to up to 4 nearby enemies. After casting you become Centered.

Centered: Your Holy Fire and Smite casts are 20% faster and reduce the cooldown of Holy Word: Chastise by 2 seconds. This effect has five charges plus an additional charge for each chain target.

enchants.name: Circle of Life
enchants.tooltip: Casting Flash Heal, Greater Heal, Prayer of Healing and Circle of Healing reduces the cooldown of Halo by 0 sec.

enchants.name: Dark Focus
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing damage with Shadow Word: Pain, Mind Flay or Mind Sear has a 15% chance to cause your next Mind Blast to have no cooldown and cost no mana.

This effect can only occur once every 6 seconds.

enchants.name: Divine Symmetry
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Penance
Dealing damage with Penance empowers your next healing Penance, and healing with Penance empowers your next damaging Penance. Empowered Penances are 30% more powerful and each hit reduces cooldown of Penance by 0.75 seconds.

enchants.name: Endless Void
enchants.tooltip:
Your Mind Blast casts extends the periodic Shadow damage increase granted from Void Eruption by 5 sec. This can exceed the original duration.
@s:2110185:0:s@

enchants.name: Energizing Prayer
enchants.tooltip: When Desperate Prayer restores you to full health it replenishes 25% of your total mana and if also used while not in combat, the cooldown of Desperate Prayer is reduced by 50%.

enchants.name: Faith Rekindled
enchants.tooltip:
Each time your Renew heals a target they receive Faith.
Faith: All healing received increased by 1% and healing received from your Renew increased by 5%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 4 sec.

enchants.name: Good Fortune
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Serendipity
Casting Renew triggers Serendipity.

Consuming a fully stacked Serendipity increases your Holy spell critical strike chance by 7% for 12 sec.

enchants.name: Grateful Prayer
enchants.tooltip: Your Prayer of Mending heals for 35% more but has one less charge.

enchants.name: Higher Power
enchants.tooltip: When your mana is above 50%, Greater Heal has 30% increased critical effect chance but costs 20% more mana. When your mana is below 50%, Greater Heal costs 30% less mana.

enchants.name: Holy Servitude
enchants.tooltip: Your Greater Heal heals an additional 12% of its healing over 12 sec. This effect can stack up to 3 times.

enchants.name: Impending Doom
enchants.tooltip:
Your Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death apply 3 charges of Impending Doom. Can store up to 9 charges.
Impending Doom: Increases the next periodic Shadow damage taken from the Priest by 20%.

enchants.name: Intense Focus
enchants.tooltip:
Reduces the cooldown of Inner Focus by 60 sec.

Casting Flash Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, or Power Word: Shield reduces the cooldown by an additional 3 sec.

enchants.name: Light and Shadow
enchants.tooltip: The critical strike chance of your Smite is increased by 8% on targets affected by your Shadow Word: Pain. In addition, the duration of Shadow Word: Pain is increased by 3 sec.

enchants.name: Light at the End of the Tunnel
enchants.tooltip: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Fire and Smite by 3%. In addition, consuming Surge of Light increases your spell haste by 1% for 18 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

enchants.name: Lightburst
enchants.tooltip: Casting Holy Fire charges your next Holy Nova, causing it to deal 25% increased damage and healing and reducing its mana cost by 100%.

enchants.name: Overflowing Light
enchants.tooltip: Healing an ally to full health with Lesser Heal, Heal or Greater Heal restores 12% base mana and increases the amount healed of your next Lesser Heal, Heal or Greater Heal by 20%. This can trigger the final rank of Serendipity if known.

enchants.name: Pendulum
enchants.tooltip: Receive 3% spell haste while above 50% mana and 3% spell critical strike chance while below 50% mana.

enchants.name: Power of Generosity
enchants.tooltip:
Casting Power Infusion on an ally grants you Power of Generosity.

Reduces cooldown of Power Infusion by 30%.
Power of Generosity: Infuses yourself with power, increasing spell casting speed by 10% and reducing the mana cost of all spells by 10%.  Lasts 15 sec.

enchants.name: Prayer Circle
enchants.tooltip: Casting Holy Fire and Prayer of Mending reduces the cast time of your next Prayer of Healing by 50% and its mana cost by 50%.

enchants.name: Promise of Renewal
enchants.tooltip: Casting Renew on an ally above 75% health reduces the mana cost of your next direct healing spell by 30% and increases its critical strike chance by 15%.

enchants.name: Psychic Influence
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Mind Flay
Your Mind Flay penetrates your enemies' souls, causing them to take 20% increased damage from Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch while channeled. 

Your Mind Sear causes the main target to suffer an additional 15% damage for every other enemy hit by Mind Sear.

enchants.name: Psychic Infusion
enchants.tooltip:
Using Psychic Scream also roots the enemy. 

Psychic Scream on enemies affected by your Shadow Word: Pain restores 10% of your mana.

enchants.name: Purgation by Light
enchants.tooltip: Your Holy Fire also deals 30% of its instant damage to up to 3 enemies within 8 yards and applies its damage over time effect to each enemy hit.

enchants.name: Purity of Light
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Surge of Light
Surge of Light no longer prevents a critical strike from Flash Heal or Smite and allows it to be stacked up to 2 times. However, Surge of Light only reduces the mana cost by 60%.

enchants.name: Radiant Star
enchants.tooltip:
Increases the effectiveness of Divine Star by 10% and casting Divine Star resets the cooldown of Holy Fire. 

When your Holy Fire deals periodic damage the cooldown of Divine Star is reduced by 0.5 sec.

enchants.name: Refilling the Well
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Lightwell
Lightwell now heals 5 additional times.

Casting direct Holy healing spells reduce the cooldown of Lightwell by 0 seconds.

enchants.name: Renewed Through Absolution
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Penance
Penance consumes your Renew to heal your target and nearby allies for an additional ${213*0.99)+(0*0.7} Holy healing.

Consuming Renew this way also reduces the duration of your active Weakened Soul by 3 sec.

enchants.name: Shadow Reserves
enchants.tooltip: Your Spirit Tap effect also increases the damage of Shadow Word: Pain and Devouring Plague by 10%, and reduces their mana costs by 50%.

enchants.name: Shattered Renewal
enchants.tooltip:
When your Power Word: Shield breaks from damage, it restores 5% base mana to you.  This can only occur once per second.

After killing an opponent that yields experience or honor your Weakened Soul is removed from you.

enchants.name: Soul Restoration
enchants.tooltip: Casting Flash Heal or Greater Heal on an ally with Weakened Soul reduces its duration by 2 sec.

enchants.name: Spirited Penance
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Penance
Penance channel time now lasts long enough to fire an extra bolt.

enchants.name: Vampiric Death
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Vampiric Touch
Shadow Word: Death consumes your Vampiric Touch on the target to deal damage based on 60% of the total damage of your Vampiric Touch. In addition, the damage you take from your Shadow Word: Death is reduced by 40%.

enchants.name: Void Herald: Grasp of Darkness
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Grasp of Darkness. 
Grasp of Darkness: Channel dark energy, dealing 716.87 Shadow damage over 3 sec. Each time it deals damage, the cooldown of Shadowfiend is reduced by 10 sec.

Each Tentacle of the Old Gods under your control will empower its damage dealt by 15% and its the critical strike chance by 10%.

enchants.name: Void Herald: Madness of the Old Gods
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Void Herald: Whispers of the Old Gods
Using Shadowfiend summons 3 Tentacle of the Old Gods near the targeted enemy.

Summoning a Tentacle of the Old Gods increases your damage by 5% for 10 sec.

requires.name: Void Herald: Whispers of the Old Gods

enchants.name: Wanding
enchants.tooltip: Wand attacks grant you stacks that increase the cast speed of your next spell by 5%, stacks up to 5 times and lasts 6 sec.

enchants.name: Words of Healing
enchants.tooltip:
While Borrowed Time is active, your critical strike chance with Flash Heal and Penance is increased by 10%.

Casting Flash Heal reduces the cooldown of Penance by 1 second.

enchants.name: Words of Time
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Borrowed Time
The duration of your Borrowed Time is increased by 2 seconds and its charges can be stored up to 3 times.

Borrowed Time now also increases your healing power by 10% of your Intellect.

enchants.name: Wraithweaver: Echoing Shadows
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Wraithweaver: Shadow Orbs
Casting Mind Blast while you have 3 Shadow Orbs active resets its cooldown. In addition, casting Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague or Vampiric Touch grants you 1 Shadow Orb.

enchants.name: Armor of Faith
enchants.tooltip: When you cast Heal, Greater Heal, Flash Heal or Penance on an ally with Weakened Soul, they receive Armor of Faith, which heals them and up to 4 nearby allies for 15% of the heal that granted it after its duration is over or when they take damage.

enchants.name: Atonement
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing damage with Smite or Holy Fire heals a nearby ally for 281.42. Dealing damage with Penance heals three nearby allies for 141.2. Casting any of these spells grants Atonement.

When healing yourself with Atonement it is 30% less effective.
Atonement: Increases the critical chance and reduces the mana cost of your next Flash Heal or Prayer of Healing by 20%. You can store up to 3 charges.
@ext:Heals from Atonement benefits from healing modifiers and can trigger procs.:ext@

enchants.name: Discipline Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases the amount absorbed from Divine Aegis by 5% and the mana cost of Power Word: Shield, Flash Heal and Penance is reduced by 5%.

enchants.name: Divine Star
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Divine Star. 
Divine Star: Fires a Divine Star forward, traveling 30 yards, causing Holy damage to all enemies and healing allies within 5 yards of its path. Upon reaching its destination, it returns, also dealing damage and healing on its way back.

enchants.name: Halo
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Halo. 
Halo: Creates a ring of Holy energy around you that quickly expands and grows in power, healing raid and party members up to 30 yds away. Heals with greater effect the further away the ally is. Also increases the Holy healing taken from the caster by 8%.

enchants.name: Holy Ascension
enchants.tooltip:
Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Fire and Smite by 20%. Casting Holy Fire Increases the damage of your next two Smite casts by 20%.

When casting Guardian Spirit you gain Holy Ascension.
Holy Ascension: Reduces the cooldown of Holy Fire by 50%. 

Your Smite and Holy Fire is guaranteed to critically strike and trigger a holy explosion around the target when dealing damage. Lasts 10 sec.

enchants.name: Holy Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases the amount healed from your Flash Heal, Greater Heal, Prayer of Healing by 5% and reduces the mana cost of those spells by 5%.

enchants.name: Holy Radiance
enchants.tooltip: Healing an ally with Heal, Greater Heal or Flash Heal also heals all allies affected by your Renew for 30% of the amount.

enchants.name: Shadow Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases Shadow damage done by 3% and the critical strike chance of your Mind Flay by 5%.

enchants.name: Shadow Visions
enchants.tooltip:
@req:1115407req@
Dealing damage with Mind Flay grants you a Soul Fragment. After accumulating 6 fragments you gain Shadow Visions.

Shadow Visions: Empowers your next ability:

- Devouring Plague: Duration increased by 12 seconds.

- Mind Blast: Damage increased by 50%, and makes your next Mind Flay deal 30% increased damage with 30% increased critical strike chance.

- Vampiric Touch: Marks a target to take 20% increased periodic damage from you for 30 sec.

enchants.name: Twilight Paragon
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing direct damage with Smite and Holy Fire grants you Paragon of Light.

Paragon of Light: Increases the damage of Smite by 1% and reduces the damage taken from your Shadow Word: Death by 10%. Stacks up to 8 times. 

Shadow Word: Death consumes these stacks, dealing Twilight damage and granting Paragon of Darkness.
Paragon of Darkness: Your Mind Flay, Mind Sear and Shadow Word: Pain deal additional Twilight damage and extend Shadow Word: Pain by 3 sec. Mind Flay and Mind Sear are impervious to pushback and gain an extra tick.

enchants.name: Void Eruption
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Void Eruption. 
Void Eruption: Releases an explosive blast of pure void energy, causing Shadow damage and slowing all enemies hit by 50% for 5 seconds.

Applies Shadow Word: Pain to up to 10 enemies within 10 yards of your target. The power drawn from the Void increases your periodic Shadow damage by 25% for 10 sec.

enchants.name: Void Herald: Whispers of the Old Gods
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing damage with Shadow Word: Pain has a 33% chance to summon a Tentacle of the Old Gods to wreak havoc on your enemies. 

This can only trigger once every 3 seconds.

enchants.name: Wraithweaver: Shadow Orbs
enchants.tooltip:
When Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague or Vampiric Touch deals damage, you have a 20% chance to gain a Shadow Orb.

Shadow Orbs increases the damage of Mind Blast by 10% per orb. You can store up to 3 orbs at a time.

When fully stacked, Mind Blast consumes your Shadow Orbs to send a Shadowy Apparition towards the target dealing ${320*0.99)+(0*0.32} Shadow damage to all enemies within 5 yds when it reaches the target.

enchants.name: Zany Zealot
enchants.tooltip: Your damaging Priest spell casts have a 15% chance to cast an additional random Priest spell for free.

enchants.name: Absolution
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the mana cost of your Dispel Magic, Cure Disease, Abolish Disease and Mass Dispel spells by 15%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Absolution Talent.

enchants.name: Afterkindling
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your damage done by 5% to targets affected by your Holy Fire and reduces the mana cost of Smite and Holy Fire by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Afterkindling Talent.

enchants.name: Blessed Recovery
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, Blessed Recovery heals you for 15% of the damage taken over 6 sec.  Additional critical hits taken during the effect increase the healing received.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Blessed Recovery Talent.

enchants.name: Blessed Vengeance
Dark Power Well
enchants.tooltip: Casting damaging Shadow spells has a 15% chance to make your next non-Shadow spell have no cost.

enchants.name: Darkness
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your Shadow spell damage by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Darkness Talent.

enchants.name: Divine Fury
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal and Greater Heal spells by 0.5 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Divine Fury Talent.

enchants.name: Glyph of Circle of Healing
enchants.tooltip: Your Circle of Healing spell heals 1 additional target.

enchants.name: Glyph of Dispel Magic
enchants.tooltip: Your Dispel Magic spell also heals your target for 3% of maximum health.

enchants.name: Glyph of Dispersion
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown on Dispersion by -45 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Fade
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown of your Fade spell by -9 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Fear Ward
enchants.tooltip: Reduces cooldown and duration of Fear Ward by -60 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Flash Heal
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the mana cost of your Flash Heal by 10%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Guardian Spirit
enchants.tooltip: If your Guardian Spirit lasts its entire duration without being triggered, the cooldown is reset to 1 min.

enchants.name: Glyph of Holy Fire
enchants.tooltip: Holy Fire is guaranteed to critically strike on targets who have 80% health or higher. Additionally, the Holy Fire Periodic effect can now critically strike.

enchants.name: Glyph of Holy Nova
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage and healing of your Holy Nova spell by an additional 25%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Hymn of Hope
enchants.tooltip: Your Hymn of Hope lasts an additional 2 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Inner Fire
enchants.tooltip: Increases the armor and spell power gained from your Inner Fire spell by 50%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Lightwell
enchants.tooltip: Increases the amount healed by your Lightwell by 20% and your Lightwell can now heal 3 additional times before expiring.

enchants.name: Glyph of Long Renewal
enchants.tooltip: Your Renew now lasts for 6 additional seconds but heals for 20% less per tick.

enchants.name: Glyph of Mass Dispel
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the mana cost of Mass Dispel by 35%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Mind Control
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the chance targets will resist or break your Mind Control spell by an additional 17%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Mind Flay
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage done by your Mind Flay spell by 10% when your target is afflicted with Shadow Word: Pain.

enchants.name: Glyph of Mind Sear
enchants.tooltip: Increases the radius of effect on Mind Sear by 5 yards.

enchants.name: Glyph of Pain Suppression
enchants.tooltip: Allows Pain Suppression to be cast while stunned.

enchants.name: Glyph of Penance
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown of Penance by -2 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Power Word: Shield
enchants.tooltip: Your Power Word: Shield also heals the target for 20% of the absorption amount.

enchants.name: Glyph of Prayer of Healing
enchants.tooltip: Your Prayer of Healing spell also heals an additional 25% of its initial heal over 6 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Psychic Scream
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of your Psychic Scream by 2 sec. and increases its cooldown by 8 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Renew
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the duration of your Renew by -3 sec. but increases the amount healed each tick by 35%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Scourge Imprisonment
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cast time of your Shackle Undead by -1.0 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Shadow
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Shadowform
While in Shadowform, your non-periodic spell critical strikes increase your spell power by 30% of your Spirit for 10 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Shadow Word: Death
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the damage you take from Shadow Word: Death by 25% and targets below 35% health take an additional 1% damage for every 1% health they are under 35%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Shadow Word: Pain
enchants.tooltip: The periodic damage ticks of your Shadow Word: Pain spell restore 1% of your base mana.

enchants.name: Glyph of Smite
enchants.tooltip: Your Smite spell inflicts an additional 20% damage against targets afflicted by Holy Fire.

enchants.name: Glyph of Spirit of Redemption
enchants.tooltip:
Increases the duration of Spirit of Redemption by 6 sec.

While Spirit of Redemption is active, your healing done is increased by 15%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Surge of Light
enchants.tooltip: Increases the effectiveness of Smite and Flash heal by 30% when under the effects of Surge of Light.

enchants.name: Healing Focus
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks  while casting any holy healing and damaging spell by 70%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Healing Focus Talent.

enchants.name: Holy Power Well
enchants.tooltip: Casting damaging Holy spells has a 15% chance to make your next non-Holy spell have no cost.

enchants.name: Holy Reach
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing, Holy Nova, Divine Hymn and Circle of Healing spells by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Holy Reach Talent.

enchants.name: Holy Specialization
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 5%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Holy Specialization Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Healing
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Divine Hymn and Penance spells by 15%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Healing Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Inner Fire
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the effect of your Inner Fire spell by 45%, and increases the total number of charges by 12.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Inner Fire Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Mana Burn
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 1 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Mana Burn Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Mind Blast
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 2.5 sec., and while in Shadowform your Mind Blast also has a 100% chance to reduce all healing done to the target by 20% for 10 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Mind Blast Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Power Word: Fortitude
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the effect of your Power Word: Fortitude and Prayer of Fortitude spells by 30%, and increases your total Stamina by 4%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Power Word: Fortitude Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Power Word: Shield
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 15%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Power Word: Shield Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Psychic Scream
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 4 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Psychic Scream Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Renew
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 15%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Renew Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 12%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Shadow Word: Pain Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Spirit Tap
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Your Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death critical strikes have a 100% chance and your Mind Flay critical strikes have a 50% chance to increase your total Spirit by 30%. For the duration, your mana will regenerate at a 50% rate while casting. Lasts 10 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Spirit Tap Talent.

enchants.name: Inner Focus
Inspiration
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces your target's physical damage taken by 10% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from your Flash Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Binding Heal, Penance, Prayer of Mending, Prayer of Healing, or Circle of Healing spell.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Inspiration Talent.

enchants.name: Martyrdom
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Gives you a 100% chance to gain the Focused Casting effect that lasts for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike.  The Focused Casting effect reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Priest spells and decreases the duration of Interrupt effects by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Martyrdom Talent.

enchants.name: Meditation
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Meditation Talent.

enchants.name: Mental Agility
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the mana cost of your instant cast spells by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Mental Agility Talent.

enchants.name: Searing Light
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage of your Smite, Holy Fire, Holy Nova and Penance spells by 15%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Searing Light Talent.

enchants.name: Shadow Affinity
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the threat generated by your Shadow spells by 25%, and you receive 15% of your base mana when your Shadow Word: Pain or Vampiric Touch spells are dispelled.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Shadow Affinity Talent.

enchants.name: Shadow Focus
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your chance to hit with your Shadow spells by 3%, and reduces the mana cost of your Shadow spells by 6%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Shadow Focus Talent.

enchants.name: Shadow Reach
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Shadow Reach Talent.

enchants.name: Shadow Weaving
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Your Shadow damage spells have a 100% chance to increase the Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 15 sec.  Stacks up to 5 times.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Shadow Weaving Talent.

enchants.name: Silent Resolve
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the threat generated by your Holy and Discipline spells by 20% and reduces the chance your helpful spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled by 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Silent Resolve Talent.

enchants.name: Spell Warding
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces all spell damage taken by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Spell Warding Talent.

enchants.name: Spirit Tap
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Gives you a 100% chance to gain a 100% bonus to your Spirit after killing a target that yields experience or honor.  For the duration, your mana will regenerate at a 100% rate while casting.  Lasts 15 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Spirit Tap Talent.

enchants.name: Twin Disciplines
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage and healing done by your instant spells by 5%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Twin Disciplines Talent.

enchants.name: Unbreakable Will
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects done to you by an additional 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Unbreakable Will Talent.

abilities.name: Dispel Magic
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Dispels magic on the target, removing 2 harmful spells from a friend or 2 beneficial spells from an enemy.

abilities.name: Divine Spirit
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Holy power infuses the target, increasing their Spirit by 40 for 30 min.

abilities.name: Fear Ward
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Wards the friendly target against Fear.  The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward.  Lasts 3 min.

abilities.name: Inner Fire
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 1395 and spell power by 42.  Each melee or ranged damage hit against the priest will remove one charge.  Lasts 30 min or until 20 charges are used.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Allows the friendly party or raid target to levitate, floating a few feet above the ground.  While levitating, the target will fall at a reduced speed and travel over water.  Any damage will cancel the effect.  Lasts 2 min.

abilities.name: Mana Burn
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Destroy 10% of the target's mana (up to a maximum of 20% of your own maximum mana). For each mana destroyed in this way, the target takes 0.5 Shadow damage.

abilities.name: Mass Dispel
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Dispels magic in a 15 yard radius, removing 1 harmful spell from each friendly target and 1 beneficial spell from each enemy target.  Affects a maximum of 10 friendly targets and 10 enemy targets.  This dispel is potent enough to remove Magic effects that are normally undispellable.

abilities.name: Pain Suppression
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Instantly reduces a friendly target's threat by 5%, reduces all damage taken by 40% and increases resistance to Dispel mechanics by 65% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Penance
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 205 Holy damage to an enemy, or 570 to 643 healing to an ally instantly and every 0.95 sec for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Power Word: Fortitude
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Power infuses the target, increasing their Stamina by 54 for 30 min.

abilities.name: Power Word: Shield
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Draws on the soul of the friendly target to shield them, absorbing 679 damage.  Lasts 30 sec.  While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage.  Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Shackle Undead
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Shackles the target undead enemy for up to 50 sec.  The shackled unit is unable to move, attack or cast spells.  Any damage caused will release the target.  Only one target can be shackled at a time.

abilities.name: Abolish Disease
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Attempts to cure 1 disease effect on the target, and 1 more disease effect every 3 seconds for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Binding Heal
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals a friendly target and the caster for 541.  Low threat.

abilities.name: Circle of Healing
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals up to 5 friendly party or raid members within 15 yards of the target for 347.

abilities.name: Cure Disease
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Removes 1 disease from the friendly target.

abilities.name: Desperate Prayer
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Instantly heals the caster for 333.

abilities.name: Divine Hymn
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals 3 nearby lowest health friendly party or raid targets within 40 yards for 1101 to 1240 every 2 sec for 8 sec, and increases healing done to them by 10% for 8 sec. Maximum of 12 heals. The Priest must channel to maintain the spell.

abilities.name: Flash Heal
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals a friendly target for 596.

abilities.name: Greater Heal
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A slow casting spell that heals a single target for 1416.

abilities.name: Guardian Spirit
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Calls upon a guardian spirit to watch over the friendly target. The spirit increases the healing received by the target by 40%, and also prevents the target from dying by sacrificing itself.  This sacrifice terminates the effect but heals the target of 50% of their maximum health. Lasts 10 sec.

abilities.name: Holy Fire
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Consumes the enemy in Holy flames that cause 797 to 979 Holy damage and an additional 203 Holy damage over 7 sec.

abilities.name: Holy Nova
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 181 to 209 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 218 to 252.  These effects cause no threat.

abilities.name: Hymn of Hope
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Restores 3% mana to 3 nearby low mana friendly party or raid targets every 1 sec for 8 sec, and increases their total maximum mana by 20% for 8 sec. Maximum of 12 mana restores. The Priest must channel to maintain the spell.

abilities.name: Lesser Heal
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heal your target for 162.

abilities.name: Lightwell
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Creates a Holy Lightwell. 

Lightwell will attempt to heal a nearby party or raid member within 20 yards every second if they have less than 50% health for 876.68. 

Lightwell lasts for 30 seconds or until it heals 10 times.

abilities.name: Prayer of Healing
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A powerful prayer heals the friendly target's party members within 30 yards for 718.

abilities.name: Prayer of Mending
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 372 the next time they take damage.  When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards.  Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump.  This spell can only be placed on one target at a time.

abilities.name: Renew
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals the target for 700 over 15 sec.

abilities.name: Resurrection
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Brings a dead player back to life with 750 health and 1000 mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Smite an enemy for 384 to 428 Holy damage.

abilities.name: Devouring Plague
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Afflicts the target with a disease that causes 976 Shadow damage over 24 sec. 15% of damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster. This spell can only affect one target at a time.

abilities.name: Dispersion
abilities.tooltipTemplate: You disperse into pure Shadow energy, reducing all damage taken by 90%.  You are unable to attack or cast spells, but you regenerate 6% mana every 1 sec for 6 sec. Dispersion can be cast while stunned, feared or silenced and clears all snare and movement impairing effects when cast, and makes you immune to them while dispersed.

abilities.name: Fade
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Fade out, temporarily reducing all your threat for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Mind Blast
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Blasts the target for 508 to 536 Shadow damage.

abilities.name: Mind Control
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Controls a humanoid mind up to level 62, but increases the time between its attacks by 25%.  Lasts up to 10 sec.

This spell only works versus players.

abilities.name: Mind Flay
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 363 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

abilities.name: Mind Sear
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes an explosion of shadow magic around the enemy target, causing 101 to 108 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 5 sec to all enemies within 10 yards around the target.

abilities.name: Mind Soothe
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Soothes the target, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards.  Only affects Humanoid targets.  Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Mind Vision
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min.  Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.

abilities.name: Psychic Horror
abilities.tooltipTemplate: You terrify the target, causing them to tremble in horror for 3 sec and drop their main hand and ranged weapons for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Psychic Scream
abilities.tooltipTemplate: The caster lets out a psychic scream, causing 5 enemies within 8 yards to flee for 8 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

abilities.name: Shadow Protection
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases the target's resistance to Shadow spells by 60 for 30 min.

abilities.name: Shadow Word: Death
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A word of dark binding that inflicts 585 to 679 Shadow damage to the target.  If the target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, the caster takes damage equal to the damage inflicted upon the target.

abilities.name: Shadow Word: Pain
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A word of darkness that causes 798 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

abilities.name: Shadowfiend
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Creates a shadowy fiend to attack the target.  Caster receives 5% mana when the Shadowfiend attacks. Damage taken by area of effect attacks is reduced. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Vampiric Touch
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes 505 Shadow damage over 15 sec to your target and causes up to 10 party or raid members to gain 1% of their maximum mana per 5 sec when you deal damage from Mind Blast. In addition, if the Vampiric Touch is dispelled it will cause 808 damage to the afflicted target.
